SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Misc. File No. 446/38
REGISTRY
6797 A
West Hongkew Station
Date October 26th, 38

Further REPORT

Subject Alleged firing of 5 pistol shots into room No. 259 of the New
Shanghai Hotel No. 82 Tsungming Road at 9 p.m. on the 23-10-38.

Made by D.S. Rossington. Forwarded by [Signature] Inspector,
Officer i/c.

Sir,

Further to this file.

J.D.C. Masuda attached to Hongkew Station, reports having
interviewed Mr. Takegi and obtained a statement which reads as
follows:-

My name is ... Takegi residing in room No. 259 of the
New Shanghai Hotel No. 82 Tsungming ... .

At about 9.40 p.m. 23-10-38 whilst I was writing a
letter re business near the window facing North Kiangse Road
I heard a crack something like a pistol shot. After about
one minute another crack more like a pistol shot was heard.

This time I realized somebody was firing shots so I
thought something unusual was happening and left the window.
At the same time I heard a third shot. One of the window
panes in my room cracked as having been struck by some solid
article.

I then approached the wall adjoining the window and
removed the curtain which was hung on the window and found
a round hole made in a window pane. I then thought someone
was aiming at my room so I decided to leave the room and
proceeded to the door.

At the time of my departure from the room I heard a
fourth shot. I then went to the telephone box and called
the men in the office of the hotel.

When I returned from the telephone box I heard the
fifth shot in the front of my room.

D.S.I. Evans of the Arms Identification Section has since
inspecting the hole in the window and is of the opinion that
same was made by a bullet from a small bore rifle or a missile

（左侧边缘批注及印章）：
P.K. 27/10
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 27 OCT 38）

补充报告

事由：据称于1938年10月23日晚9时，有人向崇明路82号新上海饭店259房间发射了5发手枪子弹。

报告人：巡佐 Rossington。呈送人：[签名] 督察，主管警官。

先生：

就本档案事宜续报如下。

配属虹口警署的日本侦探增田（Masuda）报告称，其已会见武木（Takegi）先生并取得一份陈述，内容如下：

本人名为……武木（Takegi），居住于崇明路 ____ 号新上海饭店259房间。

1938年10月23日晚9时40分左右，当我在面向北江西路的窗边书写一封关于业务的信件时，我听到一声类似手枪射击的爆裂声。大约一分钟后，又听到一声更像手枪射击的爆裂声。

这次我意识到有人在开枪，心想发生了不寻常的事情，便离开了窗口。与此同时，我听到了第三声枪响。我房间里的一块窗玻璃因被某种固体物体击中而破裂。

随后我走近窗户旁边的墙壁，取下挂在窗户上的窗帘，发现窗玻璃上有一个圆孔。我当时认为有人正瞄准我的房间，于是决定离开房间，走向门口。

在我离开房间时，我听到了第四声枪响。接着我走到电话亭，给饭店办公室的人员打电话。

当我从电话亭回来时，我在我房间的前方听到了第五声枪响。

武器识别科的巡佐伊万斯（Evans）随后检查了窗户上的孔洞，他认为该孔洞是由小口径步枪子弹或弹丸造成的

（左侧边缘批注及印章）：
P.K. 10月27日
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特别科 1938年10月27日）
（手写批注：Yes B / M / 10月27日）
P. A 致 D. C. (特别科)

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Misc. File No. 446/38
West Hongkew B. REGISTRY
Station 8797
REPORT
Date October 24th / 38

Subject Alleged firing of 5 pistol shots into room No. 259 of the New
Shanghai Hotel No. 82 Tsungming Road at 9 p.m. on the 23-10-38.

Made by D.C. Rossington. Forwarded by [Signature] Inspector,
Officer i/c.

Sir,

At 10.30 a.m. on the 24-10-38, a telephone message was re-
ceived from the D.O.'C' reporting 5 pistol shots having been fired
into room No. 259 situated on the 1st floor, facing west, of the
New Asia Hotel, at approximately 9 p.m. on the 23-10-38 and order-
ing all available men to carry out a search in the vicinity.

On receipt of the aforementioned telephone call the
following personnel attended the scene and between 10.45 a.m.
and 12.45 p.m. carried out a search in all houses and alleyways
east of North Kiangsu Road, west of the barriers off North
Szechuen Road, south of Tsepo Road and north of Tiendong Road
but without locating anyone who had heard shots fired during the
evening of the 23-10-38 and without finding anything of an
incriminating nature.

Inspector Blenkinsop, Inspector Trego, S.I. Shields, C.I.
Gray, D.C.Io. Moir, Smith, D.B. Craig, F.Ss. Crane and Sadler,
J.D.S. 137, J.D.C. 209, and 22, S.I. Zang Soo, D.S.Ic. Tao Kung
Yong and Tao Xuen Loong, C.J.Ss. 4, 34, 68, 140, 154 and 234,
and C.D.Cs. 61, 77, 105, 134, 220, 223, 263, 298, 310, 343 and
the undersigned.

The D.O.'C' and A.D.O.'C' also attended the scene.

At 2.10 p.m., the D.O.'C', A.D.O.'C', Supt. Mirai, Sen. Det.
i/c. Hongkew and West Hongkew, D.S.I. Watanabe and the undersigned
visited the New Asia Hotel and learned that the shots had been
fired into room 259 of the New Shanghai Hotel, No. 82 Tsungming
Road, the room in question being situated on the first floor,
facing west and approximately 50 yards north of Tsungming Road.
(The New Shanghai Hotel was formerly known as the Herring
Apartments).

（左侧页边手写批注：）
C 25/10
Rossington
[Signature]
29/10

事由：据称于1938年10月23日晚9时，有人向崇明路82号新上海饭店259房间发射了5发手枪子弹。

报告人：侦探长 Rossington。呈送人：[签名] 督察，主管警官。

先生：

1938年10月24日上午10时30分，接到C区值班警官的电话留言，报告称约于1938年10月23日晚9时，有人向位于一楼、朝西的新亚饭店259房间发射了5发手枪子弹，并命令所有可用人员在附近进行搜索。

接到上述电话后，下列人员赶赴现场，并于上午10时45分至下午12时45分之间，在北江苏路以东、北四川路障碍物以西、芝罘路以南及天潼路以北的所有房屋和弄堂内进行了搜查，但未找到任何在1938年10月23日晚间听到枪声的人，也未发现任何具有指控性质的物品。

参与人员包括：Blenkinsop 督察、Trego 督察、高级巡佐 Shields、首席巡佐 Gray、侦探长 Io. Moir、Smith、侦探员 Craig、外勤巡佐 Crane 和 Sadler、日本侦探员 137号、日本侦探 209号和22号、高级巡佐 Zang Soo、巡佐伊万斯 Tao Kung Yong 和 Tao Xuen Loong、中国巡佐 4号、34号、68号、140号、154号和234号，以及中国侦探 61号、77号、105号、134号、220号、223号、263号、298号、310号、343号和具名人。

C区值班警官和助理值班警官也赶赴现场。

下午2时10分，C区值班警官、助理值班警官、Mirai 警司、虹口及虹口西区资深侦探主管、巡佐伊万斯 Watanabe 以及具名人前往新亚饭店，获悉枪击目标是位于崇明路82号新上海饭店的259房间，该房间位于一楼，朝西，距离崇明路以北约50码。（新上海饭店前身为赫林公寓 Herring Apartments）。

（左侧页边手写批注：）
C 10月25日
Rossington
[签名]
10月29日

The party then visited room No. 259 of the New Shanghai Hotel and learned that at approximately 9 p.m. on the 23-10-38 the occupant of the room named,
Mr. S. Takagi, 23, clerk employed by the N.Y.K. Steamship Company,
whilst sitting before a small desk table facing the window with the curtains drawn, has heard 5 shots fired during a period of about 3 minutes, the 3rd shot having struck the window making a small hole. The occupant then called the manager Mr. T. Rugawa who in turn reported to the Japanese Gendarmerie at the Bridge House. Cpl. As the occupant Mr. S. Takagi was absent during detective's visit his version of the affair could not be obtained, D.S.I. Watanabe has therefore been detailed to interview him on his return.

MAINICHI 25-10-39

FIVE SHOTS FIRED AT NEW SHANGHAI HOTEL FROM
BRITISH SECTOR IN SETTLEMENT

At about 8.40 p.m. October 23
the firing of five shots was heard between the New
Shanghai Hotel on Soong Ming Road and the British sector
in the Settlement. One of the shots penetrated a
window pane of room No. 259 on the second floor of the
New Shanghai Hotel, which is occupied by Mr. S. Takagi.
Mr. Takagi informed the Japanese Military Police and
officers were dispatched to the scene to make an investigation.
The officers could make no arrests because it was a dark
night and the district lay in the British sector.
The hotel is situated on the
boundary between the Japanese sector and the British sector.
In day time the traffic in the vicinity of the place is
very heavy and anti-Japanese elements are free to move about
in the locality. Anti-Japanese elements are believed
to be responsible for the shooting.

《每日新闻》 1939年10月25日

五发子弹从租界英界射向新上海饭店

10月23日晚8时40分左右，
在宋明路（Soong Ming Road，即崇明路）的新上海饭店与租界英界之间
听到了五声枪响。其中一发子弹穿透了新上海饭店二楼259房间的一扇窗玻璃，
该房间由 S. Takagi 先生居住。
Takagi 先生通知了日本宪兵队，
官员被派往现场进行调查。
由于天色漆黑且该地区位于英界，
官员未能实施逮捕。
该饭店位于
日界与英界的边界处。
白天该地附近的交通
非常繁忙，反日分子可以自由在该地区活动。
据信此次枪击事件系反日分子所为。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Hongkew Station,
Further REPORT
Date October 26 19 38.

Subject Shot alleged to have been fired from the vicinity of North
Kiangse Road into Room No. 268 New Shanghai Hotel, No. 82 Tsun-ming Rd.
Made by D.S.I. Smith. Forwarded by ____________________

Sir,

Further to Diary No. 1, at 10.45 a.m. 26/10/38, a telephone
message was received at West Hongkew Station from D.D.O. "C"
to the effect that he had received information that another
stone had been thrown at the window of room number 267 of the New
Shanghai Hotel. This room is situated next to the one that
forms the precis of Diary No. 1.

Upon receipt of the above message D.S. Rossington,
D.S.I. Watanabe and J.D.S. Suga immediately proceeded to room
267 New Shanghai Hotel and were met by First Class Private
Hekekji attached to the Japanese Military Police.

Enquiries ascertained that after the stones had been
thrown at the window of Room No. 268 at 7.40 p.m. 25/10/38,
the Chinese occupant of Room 267 moved to another part of the
hotel. After the occupant left the manager of the hotel saw
that the room was intact at 10.30 p.m. 25/10/38. However at
10.30 a.m. 26/10/38 when Corp Yoshida attached to the Japanese
Military Police visited the room during the course of enquiries
into this case, he found a hole measuring about one inch in
diameter in the room window. There is a large number of cracks
surrounding the hole.

D.S.I. Ewins, Arms Identification Section examined the
window and stated that he was of the opinion that the hole was
made by a stone. A report on his examination will be submitted
in due course.

D.S.I. Mason, Finger Print Bureau also attended and
photographed the damaged window.

C.D.C. 298 was on duty on North Kiangse Road between
Tsepoo Rd and Tsungming Rd from 11 p.m. 25/10/38 to 7 a.m.

补充报告
日期 1938年10月26日。

事由：据称有人从北江西路附近向崇明路82号新上海饭店268房间开枪。
报告人：巡佐伊万斯 Smith。呈送人：___

先生：

继日记第1号之后，1938年10月26日上午10时45分，虹口西区警署收到C区副值班警官的电话留言，称其收到情报，又有石块被扔向新上海饭店267房间的窗户。该房间紧邻日记第1号摘要中所述的房间。

收到上述消息后，巡佐 Rossington、巡佐伊万斯 Watanabe 和日本侦探员 Suga 立即前往新上海饭店267房间，并会见了配属日本宪兵队的一等兵 Hekekji。

经查询查明，1938年10月25日晚7时40分石块被扔向268房间窗户后，267房间的中国住客搬到了饭店的另一部分。住客离开后，饭店经理于1938年10月25日晚10时30分查看房间，发现房间完好无损。然而，1938年10月26日上午10时30分，配属日本宪兵队的 Yoshida 下士在调查此案过程中访问该房间时，发现房间窗户上有一个直径约一英寸的孔洞。孔洞周围有大量裂纹。

武器识别科的巡佐伊万斯 Ewins 检查了窗户，并表示他认为该孔洞是由石块造成的。其检查报告将适时提交。

指纹局的巡佐伊万斯 Mason 也到场并拍摄了受损窗户的照片。

中国侦探 298号于1938年10月25日晚11时至次日早上7时在芝罘路与崇明路之间的北江西路上执勤。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Hongkew Station,
REPORT
Date Oct. 25, 19 38.
Subject Shot alleged to have been fired from the vicinity of North
Kiangse Road into Room No. 260 New Shanghai Hotel, No. 92 Tsungming Rd.
Made by I. Smith, Forwarded by____________________

Sir,
At 7.45 p.m. 25/10/38 a telephone message was received by
J.P... 56 from Mr. Fesun, Manager, New Shanghai Hotel No. 92
Tsungming Road to the effect that a pistol had been fired on
North Kiangse Road near the hotel.

J. P... 56, ... 160 and ... immediately
proceeded to the New Shanghai Hotel and found that a
shot had been fired at the window of Room 260 occupied by
Mr. Hoo Su Chang (胡寿昌) Social Affairs Bureau,
Shanghai City Government.

Investigating Officers proceeded to Room 260 and found
members of the Japanese Military Police there conducting enquiries.
Mr. Hoo Su Chang when questioned by the undersigned stated
that at about 7.40 p.m. 25/10/38 whilst he, his young daughter
named Hoo Mei Ni (胡國美) age 10 years and two Chinese male
friends named Lo Wen Ta (徐韞和) Education Bureau, formerly
Shanghai City Government and Liou Kah Lang (劉家琅) Social
Affairs Bureau, formerly Shanghai City Government were sitting
in the room conversing they heard a report which sounded similar
to that of a pistol shot which was followed by an hard object
striking the room window.

Examination of the room window which about 18 feet from
the ground and overlooking North Kiangse Road showed four specks
of grey coloured dirt in the shape of a square about one inch
apart. Nothing further was found on the window or windowsledge.
Examination of the room walls, door and floor and a search
of the room failed to reveal anything that would suggest a
bullet had entered the room.

Investigating officers accompanied by two members of the
Japanese Military Police then searched the pavement of North

1938年10月25日晚7时45分，J.P... 56 接到崇明路92号新上海饭店经理 Fesun 先生的电话留言，称饭店附近的北江西路上有人开枪。

J. P... 56, ... 160 和 ... 立即
前往新上海饭店，发现有人向胡寿昌（Hoo Su Chang）先生居住的260房间窗户开枪，胡先生任职于上海市政府社会局。

调查警官前往260房间，发现日本宪兵队成员正在那里进行调查。
具名人询问胡寿昌先生时，他表示1938年10月25日晚7时40分左右，当他与他10岁的女儿胡國美（Hoo Mei Ni）以及两位中国男性朋友——曾任上海市政府教育局职员的徐韞和（Lo Wen Ta）和曾任上海市政府社会局职员的劉家琅（Liou Kah Lang）——在房间内交谈时，他们听到一声类似手枪射击的响声，随后有硬物击中房间窗户。

对距地面约18英尺、俯瞰北江西路的房间窗户进行检查，发现四个呈方形分布、间距约一英寸的灰色污点。窗户或窗台上未发现其他物品。
对房间墙壁、门和地板的检查以及对房间的搜查，均未发现任何表明有子弹进入房间的痕迹。

    . . . 114 Mr was on post duty at the corner of N.Kiangse

    . . . 119B patrolling 3 foot 4 section when questioned
stated that at 7.40 p.m. he was walking along N.Kiangse Road and
was about 50 yards south of Tsepoo Road, but he did not see or
hear anything unusual.
    Inquiries were made along the route to in N.Kiangse Road
near Tsepoo Road but no persons were located that heard anything
resembling that of a pistol shot.

noise which sounded like a stone striking glass.

found by detectives on North Kiangse Road.

    在北江西路靠近芝罘路沿线进行了查询，但未找到任何声称听到类似枪声的人员。
    芝罘路117号的一名店员张阿津（Chang Ah Jeen）称，下午7时40分左右，他听到一声类似石头击中玻璃的声响。
    侦探伊温斯（I. Ewins，军火鉴定科）检查了窗户，并称他认为窗上的痕迹是由侦探在北江西路发现的破碎混凝土这类物体造成的。
    经查询得知，大量儿童在北江西路与芝罘路附近玩耍，怀疑是这些儿童向房间窗户投掷了破碎混凝土，也可能是某个意图
